name: io.github.AndyAnh174/vibe-hnindex
description: Index and search codebases with keyword and semantic retrieval. Embeddings: Ollama, OpenAI, Voyage, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible APIs.

environmentVariables.name: HNINDEX_PROJECT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Absolute workspace binding; otherwise use current MCP client roots or indexed cwd.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: ollama (default), openai, voyage, gemini, or openai-compatible

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Override the embedding provider model

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL including version; required for openai-compatible

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Generic embedding API key override

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI embedding API key

environmentVariables.name: VOYAGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Voyage embedding API key

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Gemini embedding API key

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Alternative Gemini API key

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Texts per embedding batch (default 32, range 1-128)

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request embedding timeout in ms (default 30000); 0 disables timeout

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Extra retries for HTTP 429/5xx (default 2, range 0-5)
Ollama embedding server URL
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_URL

environmentVariables.description: Ollama embedding model name (default: bge-m3:567m)
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Embedding vector size; provider default when unset. Re-index after changing provider/model/dimensions.
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS

environmentVariables.description: Qdrant vector database URL
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_URL

environmentVariables.description: Qdrant API key (Qdrant Cloud or API-key-protected clusters)
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: SQLite database storage path (default: ~/.vibe-hnindex)
environmentVariables.name: STORAGE_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Number of worker threads for parallel indexing (default: auto = CPU-1). Set to 1 for single-threaded
environmentVariables.name: INDEX_WORKERS

environmentVariables.description: Files per worker batch during parallel indexing (default: 8)
environmentVariables.name: INDEX_PARALLEL_BATCH

environmentVariables.description: When true, omitting search mode uses auto (heuristic keyword/hybrid) — v0.5.0
environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_AUTO_ROUTE

environmentVariables.description: When not false, keyword search with zero hits runs semantic fallback (default on)
environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_KEYWORD_FALLBACK_SEMANTIC

environmentVariables.description: Enable streaming search by default — parallel keyword+semantic, progress, preview (v0.9.0)
environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_STREAM_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: Enable fuzzy search re-ranking for all searches (v0.8.1)
environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_FUZZY_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: Max cache entries for search results LRU (default: 100)
environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_CACHE_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: Cache TTL in milliseconds (default: 300000 = 5 min)
environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_CACHE_TTL_MS

environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable post-retrieval reorder (v0.6.0)
environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_RERANK

environmentVariables.description: Max distinct results in rerank pool before trimming to limit (default: 50)
environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_RERANK_POOL

environmentVariables.description: POST URL for external reranker (optional)
environmentVariables.name: RERANK_URL

environmentVariables.description: Timeout for RERANK_URL request in ms (default: 15000)
environmentVariables.name: RERANK_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Overall timeout for search operations in ms (default: 60000)
environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Timeout for Ollama API calls in ms (default: 30000)
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Timeout for Qdrant API calls in ms (default: 15000)
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Enable chat memory — auto-track tool calls, save/load/ingest context (v0.12.1)
environmentVariables.name: CHAT_MEMORY_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: Max entries in chat_context load (default: 20)
environmentVariables.name: CHAT_MEMORY_LOAD_LIMIT

environmentVariables.description: Max age in hours for context retrieval (default: 168 = 7 days)
environmentVariables.name: CHAT_MEMORY_MAX_AGE_HOURS

environmentVariables.description: Thread TTL in ms — reuse latest thread if within this window (default: 3600000 = 1h)
environmentVariables.name: CHAT_MEMORY_THREAD_TTL_MS

environmentVariables.description: Enable Qdrant vector storage for chat context — enables semantic search on load (default: true)
environmentVariables.name: CHAT_MEMORY_VECTOR_ENABLED
CODE_GRAPH_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable SQLite TS/JS code graph (default true)

environmentVariables.name: CODE_GRAPH_MAX_NODES
environmentVariables.description: Default graph traversal node cap, 1–100 (default 40)

environmentVariables.name: AST_CHUNKING
environmentVariables.description: Enable TS/JS AST chunks (default true); re-index after changes

environmentVariables.name: RERANK_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Optional reranker: none, http or voyage

environmentVariables.name: RERANK_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Voyage rerank model (default rerank-3-lite)

environmentVariables.name: RERANK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer key for rerank; Voyage can use VOYAGE_API_KEY
